newsitem.title: USA: Abbott Labs says asthma drug available.
newsitem.headline: Abbott Labs says asthma drug available.

text.p: Abbott Laboratories said Tuesday its new drug for the prevention and treatment of asthma in patients 12 years or older is now available by prescription nationwide.
The new drug, called Zyflo, recently won approval from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration, Abbott said.
The company said Zyflo inhibits the formation of leukotrienes, molecules that contribute to the inflammation, swelling and bronchial constriction seen in the airways of asthma sufferers.
Abbott is a diversified health care company. Its shares were trading up one Tuesday afternoon at 54-5/8.
